response.what_it_is: Portable thermal tattoo printer with retail box and instruction manuals
visible_condition: item appears new or lightly handled
hidden_risks: internal battery condition and charge retention
thermal print head degradation or missing pixels
bluetooth wireless pairing and app connectivity
response.best_proof: A photo or short video showing the printer powered on with indicator lights and printing a test page
seller_claims_unsupported: wireless and mobile app operation cannot be verified from a static image
response.failure_mode: Assuming the device functions properly and holds battery charge without physical testing of the print head and wireless module
